title: Post the build: three posts from real work
purpose: Three posts from your build, drafted for you from your project: a decision, a diagram, the system in motion.
why: Screenshots alone don't land. What problem the screen represents, the decision you made, and why it matters is what makes people stop. The drafter writes each one from your project and your week; you add the screenshot, fill the brackets and post.
evidence: Link to your best post of the three.

modules.title: Write posts that sound like you

tasks.title: Screenshot + the decision behind it (start from a decision draft)
tasks.done_when: Says what problem, what you decided, why it matters.

tasks.title: Architecture or workflow diagram post (start from a build draft)
tasks.done_when: Someone who never saw the code understands the system.

tasks.title: A gif or short video of the system working (start from a build draft)
tasks.done_when: Shows the feature doing its job, start to finish.

video.title: Posts that show your work
video.summary: Turning a build into posts people stop for: the screenshot, the one sentence, the question at the end.
